messages:
alex: Bringing together final microcopy for the tri-mode landing. Need a single bundle we can drop into staging.
nora: Prefer tight, declarative heroes. No marketing adjectives. Example:
  Hosted: 'Hosted API — instant model access, pay-as-you-go'
  Dedicated: 'Dedicated — reserved GPU capacity & SLAs'
  Private: 'Private — VPC, on-prem, and KMS'
eli: Benchmark strip: 'Typical p50: ~60ms; optimized with batching & KV cache. Full benchmarks -> /benchmarks'. Link from hero.
jamie: Lead routing mapping: hosted -> trial signup (auto SDR contact); dedicated -> capacity worksheet + calendar CTA; private -> AE handoff + security checklist packet. Add hidden field `mode` on the form.
forms-bot: Example snippet: `<input type="hidden" name="mode" value="{{selected_mode}}">` Please ensure CRM mapping exists.
webinar-bot: Reminder: live demo scheduled 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC, event ID 98321.
alex: CTA variants to A/B: 'Start free' (Hosted), 'Book capacity' (Dedicated), 'Contact sales' (Private). Also test 'Watch demo' in hero for engineering audience.
nora: Add small note under hero: 'See throughput demo — 20m demo + 10m Q&A' with registration checkbox 'Evaluating Dedicated/Private' to route leads.
eli: Also surface /evals/quick-start prompt set from page for technical buyers. We'll include a one-pager PDF with latency and cost tradeoffs for the launch post.
jamie: I'll wire the UTMs: utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch, utm_content=hero_cta. Please sign off in Notion by EOD so I can push to staging tomorrow.
